content: Aaradhya Verma reached out to insurance agent Neha Kapoor to inquire about a 10% premium increase on her policy renewal. Neha explained that the increase is due to inflation and noted that a new mental health support feature (3 free online sessions per year) has been added to the base plan. Aaradhya expressed concern over the higher premium and asked if any discounts could be applied.

action_items: Check for available discounts for the customer's policy
